description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding {C}{C}.
When Izzet Chronarch dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Izzet Chronarch on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Izzet Chronarch from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Izzet Chronarch and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Izzet Chronarch triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
